title: ownCloud: attackers can get in without a password
verdictReason: Attacks are confirmed. The severity score is critical (9.8).

category.label: Documents and collaboration
category.why: It holds shared documents and internal pages.
category.doThis: Patch it, or ask your provider whether they have.

summary: ownCloud contains an improper authentication vulnerability that allows an attacker to access, modify, or delete any file without authentication if the username of a victim is known, and the victim has no signing-key configured.
fix: CISA's instruction: apply the vendor's fix, or stop using the product if no fix exists. The deadline CISA set for US federal agencies, Aug 30, 2026, has passed. It is a US government deadline; use it as a guide.

evidence.title: 1 public GitHub repository claims a proof of concept for CVE-2023-49105
CISA Vulnrichment marks CVE-2023-49105 as actively exploited
